name: goap_string_domains_honest
supersedes_and_corrects: The earlier string-domain attempt (never registered -- see patlang-goap-string-domain-vacuous-self-caught.md memory record) was self-caught as vacuous before being written here: it hand-simulated the single correct path per target with zero decoys/branching. This entry is the honest rebuild.
mechanism: friendly_cli/lib/goap_string_universe.patlang generates the FULL universe of concat(prefix, char, prefix+char) facts for EVERY prefix up to a bounded length over a small alphabet (['a','b','c'], max_len=4) and EVERY character in that alphabet -- genuinely generic, independent of any specific target, same status as pred1/succ chains in the numeric work. Every reachable state has |alphabet|=3 outgoing actions, most of which are real decoys for any one target string -- the search must reject wrong branches to find the correct one, exactly like pred2/times decoys in the numeric case.
given_background: gen_prefixes_up_to/emit_string_universe_facts (generic graph/string-universe generation, same infrastructure status as reach_closure elsewhere).

action_definitions.append_char: precond built(Id,P)+concat(P,C,P2); effect built(Id,P2) -- builds left-to-right (concatenation)
action_definitions.prepend_char: precond built(Id,P)+concat(P,C,P2) [concat facts generated with prepend=true, i.e. P2=C+P]; effect built(Id,P2) -- builds via prepending (reversal)

task_1_build_from_scratch: Targets ab, abc, cab, bca all correctly built from '' with genuine multi-branch search (3 real decoy characters available at every step); blind target 'bab' (never used to derive the universe) also correct.
task_2_concatenation: A+B via the SAME shared generic universe, starting the search from prefix A instead of '': (a,bc)->abc, (ab,c)->abc, ('',cab)->cab all correct step counts.
task_3_reverse: Reversal via prepend_char, genuine multi-branch search (no prescribed consumption order this time): abc, cab, bca, aab all correctly reach their reversed form via the shortest path of length = target length.
task_4_palindrome: Genuine COMPOSITION: expected_reverse(s) computed by the harness (verification-only, not the mechanism under test) is checked for GOAP-reachability via the SAME prepend_char search, AND compared to s via plain string equality (an already-given primitive) -- never a hand-authored palindrome algorithm. Cases aba/abc/a/''/ab/aa all correct.
negative_case: Target 'abz' ('z' outside the 3-letter alphabet) correctly returns an EMPTY plan (0 steps) -- confirms the universe genuinely constrains what's reachable, not an unconditional-match shortcut.
bugs_found_and_fixed_during_this_work: Two closure-capture bugs: functions defined after a top-level 'let' don't see that outer variable unless it's passed as an explicit parameter (found twice -- once for append_facts/prepend_facts in build_concat_test/build_reverse_test, once for prepend_facts inside goap_is_palindrome -- both silently produced scripts missing the concat facts entirely, which read initially as 'the mechanism doesn't work' before being correctly diagnosed as a scoping bug in the test harness itself, not the GOAP mechanism).
provenance: direct response to: 'Let's build the harder honest version with real decoys; the action set (possible ones) should have string builder, of course, and know about being able to add a character to a string and so on...' -- following the self-caught vacuous first attempt.
related: spec_library/synthesized_registry/goap_multi_example_composition.meta.json, spec_library/synthesized_registry/goap_packaged_loop_arbitrary_target_fixed.meta.json (the reaches-precondition fix, same discipline of real reachability constraints)
